_comment: Production-calibrated bandwidth profile for 948d (L20B, HybridConnector+v6d_object), fitted from 507,268 load + 1,349,677 store rows collected 2026-10-24/25. Replaces the DMA-sweep profile whose floor (1.7ms) misses the ~19ms RPC+objectization overhead seen in production async_swap wall clock.

_fit.store: lat_ms ~ 20.7 constant (no block dependence in 0-27 blk range; fixed_overhead dominates)
_fit.note: seg1_cross_node uncalibrated: the collection window had zero cross-node hits (507,268 loads, cross_node=False 100%). Needs dedicated cross-node traffic to calibrate.
_fit.concurrency: load p50 grows 23ms->36.5ms at concurrency 1->8; per-request queued_s stays us-level. Slowdown factor NOT yet modeled (see TODO).
